label: Food
description: How much of a population's food supply has to come from abroad.

wanted.name: Cereal import dependency ratio (%, 3-yr avg)
wanted.source: FAO Suite of Food Security Indicators (FAOSTAT)
wanted.why: Direct share of cereal supply that is imported; already 0-100.

wanted.name: Import quantity ÷ domestic supply (Food Balance Sheets)
wanted.why: Import share of consumption across all food groups (kcal or tonnes).

wanted.name: Food imports (% of merchandise imports), TM.VAL.FOOD.ZS.UN

label: Fuel & energy
description: Net energy imports relative to energy use: can the lights stay on without imports?

wanted.name: Energy imports, net (% of energy use), EG.IMP.CONS.ZS
wanted.why: Exact import-share-of-consumption measure; negative = net exporter (scores 0).

wanted.name: Net imports ÷ total energy supply, by fuel
wanted.source: IEA World Energy Balances / Energy Institute Statistical Review

label: Trade exposure
description: Economy-wide exposure to world trade (exports + imports relative to GDP). Openness, not survival needs: weighted lower by default.

wanted.name: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP), NE.IMP.GNFS.ZS
wanted.why: Import-only side; closer to dependence than total trade.

label: Medicine
description: Reliance on imported pharmaceuticals and medical supplies.

label: Minerals & metals
description: Reliance on imported critical minerals and metals.

wanted.name: Net import reliance by mineral (% of apparent consumption)
wanted.source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (US) / BGS World Mineral Statistics

wanted.name: Ores & metals imports (% of merchandise imports), TM.VAL.MMTL.ZS.UN

label: Manufactured goods
description: Reliance on imported manufactured goods and machinery.

wanted.name: Manufactures imports (% of merchandise imports), TM.VAL.MANF.ZS.UN

label: Water
description: Share of renewable freshwater that originates outside the borders.

wanted.name: Dependency ratio (% of total renewable water resources originating outside the country)
